simple.summary: יָשֵׁן (Yâshên) means Jashen , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 2Sam 23 32.

definitions.full: H3464. Yashen II. יָשֵׁן proper name, masculine one of David's heroes , 2Samuel = הָשֵׁם 1Chr 11:34 (in both strike out בְּנֵי as dittograph, We Dr Bu); see הָשֵׁם , and גוּנִי .
